dissent.internal: None. The two candidate verdicts considered were REJECTED and PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW; the deciding factor was that the defect set is mechanically fixable at the record layer and requires no owner adjudication.
dissent.note_on_scope: This proposal does not assess whether the 16 cases are the right cases to build from, nor the feasibility of the 24/24/24 plan - both are T2 scope and were deliberately not entered.
dissent.note_on_severity_balance: Had only the citation-pointer defects existed without the A-common hash violation, PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW could have been argued, since every underlying fact is true. The declared-hash mismatch is an explicit card-level auto-acceptance assertion and is what makes the proposal REJECTED rather than PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW.

justification.not_rejected_because: Not a fabrication or boundary case. All 10 fully-cited cases fact-check out exactly, including T1-INC-06 (three-source corroboration of the logits-processor call-convention mismatch against transformers 5.14.1), T1-INC-03/04 (probe_cap 4/3 and raw-overwrite disclosure verbatim), T1-INC-05 (zero-transmission single repair), T1-INC-08 (both force-add commits exist), T1-INC-09 (draft C2 FAIL on FILES.md bytes+hash then v2 PASS) and T1-INC-10 (6/13 representation difference, no content drift, confirmed by T0R-01's per-line mixed-EOL reconstruction refuting T1R-02 F7). Structure, family coverage, no-sealed-marking, B0 zero calls and write scope all recomputed clean.
justification.preserve_unchanged: Six-family coverage, three expected_category values, the 24/24/24 build-plan labelling, no-sealed marking, B0 declaration and write-scope compliance all verified clean and must not be altered during rework.
rejected_because: A-common 'declared hashes equal actual' fails: source_refs sha256 mismatches 2/31 on memory/THREADS.md (declared 0653ff3d... = authority_map.local_snapshot_raw_sha256_historical, an explicitly historical hash domain; actual worktree and git blob are both 39ba8d56...).

T1-INC-11 is mis-attributed: the harness dispatch-gap disclosure is recorded verbatim in research/tatqa_wp0_2026/wp2/LOOP_C_S4C_QUAL_AUDIT_v1.md, while the cited reviews/T1R-01/REVIEW.md contains zero occurrences of any asserted term.

T1-INC-12, T1-INC-13, T1-CTRL-01 are ledger-only citations: their asserted strings (ENGINEERING_DISPATCH_FAILURE, PR-01/04/07, NOT_IDENTIFIABLE) appear in research/positive_repair_20261011/* and docs/research/stage_e_matched_fpr_reanalysis_v1.md, none of which are cited; the cited STATE/THREADS/INDEX contain none of them.
T1-INC-13 overstates: observed_fact drops the title's round-1 qualifier, while its own cited memory/STATE.md records PR-03 v3 = NEGATIVE with 'effect measurement entered'.
T1-INC-07 and T1-CTRL-02 have mechanism clauses (offline dry-run convention reuse; 'failed transfer' plus downstream fields not recomputed) that their cited refs do not establish.

Admitting cases with wrong evidence pointers into the R-line development set would contaminate the 'evidence_coverage=1' and 'claim_overreach=0' hard gates with mis-labelled samples - circularly self-defeating.
justification.summary: Package integrity and structure recomputed clean, but the card's primary duty - traceable fact verification of each incident case - fails on 5 of 16 cases, plus 2 declared source_ref hashes that do not match the working tree (a direct violation of A-common). No fabrication was found; every underlying fact independently confirmed turned out to be true. The defects lie in evidence pointers and identity pinning - exactly the failure family this package catalogs.
justification.why_not_pending_human_review: All eight findings sit in the record layer (pointer targets, hash values, wording qualifiers, group labels, receipt phrasing). None touches a scientific conclusion, a frozen conclusion, or an authorization boundary. The fix set is mechanical and needs no owner adjudication; escalating mechanical record defects to a human gate would be disproportionate and inconsistent with the disposition precedent set by T0R-01.
